description: Products not yet on sale, in date order: a release date, an announcement event, or a window shown as written (for example Fall 2026), each with who stated it (Announced by the company, Company event, Reported date, Reported window, iDevice estimate) and how many pre-release reports it has. Defaults to the next 120 days; optional from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most one year), category (watches, earbuds, glasses, phones, rings) and company narrow it. Products with no dated or sourced window are counted, not listed.

company.description: A company or brand word, e.g. 'apple', 'samsung', 'meta'

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 120 days after from; at most 366 days.

title: Release calendar
